indication_area: Infectious disease (RSV lower respiratory tract disease prevention)
formulation: suspension for injection (recombinant RSVPreF3 antigen with AS01E adjuvant)
moa: Recombinant prefusion F protein subunit vaccine with AS01E adjuvant system

approval_evidence.quote: For Immediate Release: May 03, 2023 ... Today, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Arexvy, the first respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine approved for use in the United States.

notes: launch_quarter 2023Q3: the Q3 2023 release (6-K 2023-11-01) prints Arexvy Q3 2023 = 709 and nine months 2023 = 709, so no sales in Q1-Q2 2023; the Q2 2023 release (6-K 2023-07-26) describes only the May 2023 approval and launch preparation and prints no Arexvy sales row. The brief suggested 2023Q2/Q3; first sales are in Q3. FDA approved 2023-05-03.
